SELECT
  LEFT(o.order_id, 10) AS order_id,
  oi.order_item_id,
  LEFT(oi.seller_id, 10) AS seller_id,
  LEFT(o.customer_id, 10) AS customer_id,
  (sg.geolocation_state || ' - ' || cg.geolocation_state) AS seller_state_customer_state,
  MAX(o.order_delivered_carrier_date)::timestamp AS order_delivered_carrier_date,
  MAX(o.order_delivered_customer_date)::timestamp AS order_delivered_customer_date,
  ABS(
    CAST(
      EXTRACT(
        DAY FROM (
          MAX(o.order_delivered_customer_date)::date - MAX(o.order_delivered_carrier_date)::date
        )
      ) AS INTEGER
    )
  ) AS delivery_time_days,
  COUNT(*) AS item_count
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN geolocation sg ON s.seller_zip_code_prefix = sg.geolocation_zip_code_prefix
JOIN geolocation cg ON c.customer_zip_code_prefix = cg.geolocation_zip_code_prefix
WHERE o.order_delivered_carrier_date IS NOT NULL
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND sg.geolocation_state IS NOT NULL
  AND cg.geolocation_state IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  LEFT(o.order_id, 10),
  oi.order_item_id,
  LEFT(oi.seller_id, 10),
  LEFT(o.customer_id, 10),
  (sg.geolocation_state || ' - ' || cg.geolocation_state);
